title: The Treasure That Never Runs Out
intro: This quiz follows Lila, Jay, and Ranger Maya as they discover natural resources—renewable and non-renewable—and how we can use them wisely.

choices: Something made only in a factory
questions.explanation: A natural resource is something that comes from nature.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a renewable resource?
questions.explanation: Sunlight is a renewable resource because nature keeps replacing it.

questions.prompt: Why are coal, oil, and natural gas called non-renewable resources?
choices: They can be replaced every year
They take millions of years to form
questions.explanation: Coal, oil, and natural gas are non-renewable because they take millions of years to form.

questions.prompt: Which action helps us use natural resources wisely?
choices: Letting a car idle for a long time
Turning off lights when they are not needed
questions.explanation: Turning off lights when they are not needed helps us use natural resources wisely.

questions.prompt: What promise did Lila and Jay make?
choices: To collect as many rocks as possible
To use resources wisely and care for the Earth
questions.explanation: Lila and Jay promised to use resources wisely and care for the Earth.
